name: Japan Fund for Global Environment (JFGE) Grants Program

funder.name: Environmental Restoration and Conservation Agency of Japan (ERCA)

summary: Annual grants from a Japanese public fund for non-profit environmental organisations working in Japan or in ODA-recipient countries, covering nature protection and restoration, forest conservation, agroforestry and other conservation work; non-Japanese applicants apply through a Japan-based agent, in Japanese.

geography.label: Japan and developing regions (DAC list of ODA recipients)

reporting: Grantees submit a yearly Report on Achievements and Activities and a self-assessment sheet; multi-year grants add a mid-term consultation and an activity sharing meeting in the final year.

status.quote: Application period for FY2027 is from Oct.13 to Nov.16, 2026.
